result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Generates strongly-typed C# classes for domain types, events and commands from 
protocol definition files to be used with ChromeProtocol.

USAGE:
    dotnet cdp generate <path> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotnet cdp generate js_protocol.json mono_protocol.json -n 
DevTools.Api.Generated -o ./out

ARGUMENTS:
    <path>    Path to the .json file with the CDP schema to generate protocol   
              definitions from                                                  

OPTIONS:
                       DEFAULT                                                  
    -h, --help                      Prints help information                     
    -n, --namespace    Generated    Namespace for the generated files           
    -o, --output       Generated    Folder where generated files should be      
                                    placed                                      
        --clean        True         Should output folder be cleaned before      
                                    performing generation or not
